text: hm. i think that is in part wrong a bit. read here @GUIDING_LIGHT.md and see if this aligns

events.text: Rework landed as ruled — see req_0577 (commit 8b07e1c30): recipe in the lump, Zig rasterizer at load, baker layer deleted.

resolution: Audited the decal pixel pipeline against GUIDING_LIGHT.md as asked. Verdict: partly misaligned — it ships the PRODUCT (baked 512x512 pixels, ~50KB) where the doc says ship the RECIPE: the DecalDoc itself is a ~1KB declarative document the host's fixed systems (rect fill, FreeType text, image loading) can rasterize once at load, the exact shape shader materials already use (materialize-at-load). The bake-lever exception covers only image nodes (captured content) and shader-fill rects — those should be content-addressed blobs in the gamefile asset store, not inline lump bytes. The 'open the editor once to bake' wart is the tell: recipes bake headless with no editor/GPU dependency. Aligned parts kept: no code in the frame loop, binary lump packing, load-once materialization. Proposed rework (awaiting the user's word): pack the DecalDoc into the MATERIALS lump, add a small Zig doc rasterizer (text via the already-linked FreeType is the meat, ~200 lines), delete the DecalPixelBaker/pixel-file/staleness layer. No code changed in this pass — assessment only.
